items.rationale: The established cause is external surface flooding, not escape of water under 2.4.3. No scheduled flood cover is shown, so 3.6 bars the labour; €1,080 is conditional on cover at 12 hours × €90 gross.
Clause 3.6.2(f) bars journey charges without a covered event. If flood cover were confirmed, this first listed journey would be eligible under 7.1.7(g), at the €79 gross reference level.

Clause 3.6 bars the claim as presented. Even with flood cover, 4.3(d) and 5.2.2 exclude separate procurement of working equipment used for the billed extraction measure; €250 is a notional gross price only.
Clause 3.6 bars the claim as presented, and 5.2.2 independently rules out a separate pump charge alongside the extraction measure. The €90 gross figure is a notional deployment charge only.

Pumping out standing water is a mitigation measure under 5.2.2, but 3.6 bars it because scheduled flood cover is not shown. The conditional €450 gross covers the extraction operation, including labour and pump use.

Clause 3.6.2(c) bars materials for damage from an uninsured peril. If flood cover were confirmed, 7.1.7(c) would allow an estimated €150 gross for standard materials actually installed in the affected circuits.

items.description: Boiler, flue and storage tank renewal
items.rationale: The fixed system is insured property under 4.2.2, but 3.6 bars replacement because scheduled flood cover is not shown. The conditional €9,500 gross is for an equivalent standard boiler, flue and tank installed and commissioned under 7.1.1(c), excluding the separately listed adaptation and disposal.

Clause 3.6.2(a) expressly bars adaptation work when the underlying loss is not covered. If flood cover were confirmed, 7.1.7(d) would allow about €600 gross for necessary changes to the immediately adjoining pipework.

Disposal of unusable fixed plant falls under 5.2.1 only after an insured event, and 3.6.2(e) bars it here. The conditional €300 gross allows for ordinary removal, haulage and disposal of the old assembly.

Clause 3.6.2(f) bars the charge, and even if flood cover were confirmed, 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(d) allow only the first journey across both trades. The €79 gross figure is the reference value for one otherwise eligible journey.
